Subject: Tranche reserve coordination for pipeline forecast — weekly fleet planning

Team — putting together this week's fleet planning thread focused on the SentinelAI opportunity and how we stitch tranche/reserve requests into the current GPU pool. Quick context: SentinelAI indicated a potential Q4 start (pilot + production by Nov) and their forecast shows a steep token ramp if they go to production. HubSpot deal HS-14287 attached.

High-level asks: 
- Laura: can you confirm the committed $/month cadence vs expected close date for the top-of-funnel forecast attachment I dropped in HubSpot?
- Karthik: what tranche size (v100-equivalent slots) can Infra realistically carve out for a reserved lane starting Oct 1 with 4-week notice? Also need burst-credit policy for first 90 days.
- Grace: from Sales ops — prioritize which pipeline accounts (Sentinel + two others) should get tranche consideration next sprint.

I attached a short spreadsheet with the Sentinel forecast slices and two tranche scenarios (20-slot and 50-slot starter lanes). Please review ahead of the 3pm sync and flag any immediate blockers.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales-Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Jul 30, 2028 at 9:12 AM Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team — putting together this week's fleet planning thread focused on the SentinelAI opportunity...

Thanks Ben — looked at the HubSpot numbers and the attachment. Short answer: finance is comfortable approving a staged reserved commitment if we can get a clear cadence and a minimum 6-month commit for the tranche. Two options we can push in commercial:

1) 6-month starter reserve (20 slots) at a blended rate with monthly ramp credits if they scale prior to month 3.
2) 12-month reserve (50 slots) with an annual discount and defined burst credits for the first 90 days.

Sentinel procurement has already asked for a draft SOW and a billing cadence example (they copied procurement@sentinelai.com on the initial thread). If we plan to offer a 20-slot starter tranche, finance will need revenue recognition inputs by Aug 10.

Action: I can draft the numbers for both options and drop them into the shared Drive. Laura

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Ops & GTM Finance
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Jul 30, 2028 at 10:05 AM Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Ben — looked at the HubSpot numbers and the attachment...

Quick infra reality check:
- We can provision a 20-slot dedicated lane (A100-equivalent slices) with 4-week lead time if we accept node pinning and a slight impact to burst capacity for the pool.
- A guaranteed 50-slot tranche starting Oct 1 is possible but we'd need a confirmed start-of-billing date and a soft fallback policy for months where utilization < 30% to avoid stranded capacity.
- Burst credits: we can grant a pool-level burst of +30% for the first 60 days (subject to per-customer throttles) but anything beyond that must be throttled/backfilled by spot capacity.

Risks: Oct is already heavy for GPU procurements; if multiple large deals ask for 50+ slots we'll need to negotiate across deals or pay spot-premiums. For Sentinel specifically, we need an estimated concurrent model memory footprint (small/medium/large) to finalize the node mix.

I'll add a short infra-runbook for tranche onboarding. Karthik

Karthik Iyer
Director, Infrastructure & Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
